task.title: Modifying the allocation — Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks Line 1: Type “input modification of M175: [insert details of the modification (e.g. from E-$400-1878-1878 and E-$700-1879-1881 to E-$250-1878-1878 and E-$700-1879-1881-$350)].”
Remarks Line 4: Type the information about the BP extension if needed.
Remarks Line 5: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
